messages.welcome_message: Welcome to the Brindle inn. Papa's asleep, so I'm minding the desk.
messages.price_message: A bed is ${PRICE} coins a night. Will you stay?
messages.cancel_message: Suit yourself. Mind the mine carts.
messages.stay_message: Sleep well! Papa snores, you did not hear that from me.
messages.goodbye_message: Morning! You look rested. Off you go.
messages.not_enough_coins: That's not twelve coins. Come back when it is.
